pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal regions of medium-to-dark brown coloration. Edges exhibit high-frequency angularity with jagged pixel-level boundaries. Patch area is significantly reduced and more fragmented on the lower flank and rear extremities compared to the upper torso.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph. Junctions primarily consist of tri-radiate nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible midsection, maintaining a distinct separation between dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible dorsal ridge displays a short, dense, and uniformly serrated profile. The amplitude of the mane hairs is low, creating a jagged but consistent silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian symbiotic organism (Oxpecker) perched on the upper posterior flank near the base of the tail.
